ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

22. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash
